# PERF001: check-over-budget

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

The built-in stages of a check run took longer than the `[perf]` budget.

Only raised when the enforcement knob of the perf table is on. The
breakdown from `frob check --timing` shows which stage grew; a cold cache
(first run, new checkout) legitimately exceeds the warm budget, so rerun
before treating it as a regression.

## Examples

### PERF001 check over budget / A zero budget enforced fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
=== frob.toml
[perf]
enforce = true
budget_ms = 0
=== src/lib.rs
//! Library.
```

### PERF001 check over budget / An unenforced budget is clean #2 (line 19) (clean)

```text
=== frob.toml
[perf]
enforce = false
budget_ms = 0
=== src/lib.rs
//! Library.
```
